pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:100 heal cap is looked up by row id in session memory while every retry mints a new row whose persisted attempt (src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:963) is never checked, so auto-heal retries each child failure afresh and the lineage is unbounded - re-confirmed at registry 11037a6c

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:963 attempt is persisted per lineage but the ceiling lives in in-memory HealingAttempt keyed by row id (src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/SelfHealingPanel.tsx:78), so the budget neither survives a remount nor follows the new child row

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:45 retryability is decided by regex over error+description+title at the UI call site, so a task whose title says 'fix type error' is classed build_error regardless of how it actually failed

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/SelfHealingPanel.tsx:138 auto-heal re-dispatches a fresh failure in the same effect tick with no delay or jitter, so a deterministic failure loops back-to-back
src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:944 retry re-runs a local dev task; no issued credential to revoke (stage: multi-service)

pairs.registryProposal: durable-retries step 4 (identity-survives-reuse) could name the retry-as-new-row lineage shape explicitly: when each attempt is a fresh row with parent/attempt columns, the budget must key on the lineage root or the persisted attempt, never the row id - a recurring way the ladder silently resets.
